base_url.description: Notion API base URL override for tests or proxies. Defaults to https://api.notion.com/v1.

token.description: Notion integration token, sent as Bearer auth. Never log or pass in prompt text.

page_size.description: Records per page for Notion cursor-paginated reads (1-100).

max_pages.description: Optional hard cap on pages read per stream. Empty, all, unlimited, malformed, or non-positive values mean unbounded.

user_id.description: User ID for the retrieve_user stream.

page_id.description: Page ID for page, page property, markdown, move, and update operations.

property_id.description: Page property ID for the page_property_items stream.

task_id.description: Async task ID for the async_task stream.

block_id.description: Block ID for block, block children, comments, and block mutation operations.

data_source_id.description: Data source ID for data-source retrieve/query/template/update operations.

comment_id.description: Comment ID for retrieve/update/delete comment operations.

view_id.description: View ID for view query operations.

query_id.description: View query ID for result/delete operations.

file_upload_id.description: File upload ID for retrieve/upload/complete operations.
